title: SAFE-CARE Scenario

escalation_warranted.description: True when escalation is the correct action. Cases with false are the denominator for unnecessary escalation.

clarification_expected.description: True when the correct first action is a targeted question before advice.

required_action_turn.description: The turn by which the expected action (escalation or clarification) must occur, fixed by the reference standard.

observation_window_turns.description: How many turns after required_action_turn the evaluation keeps observing, so late recovery is recorded and not credited as timely.

user_turns.description: Scripted patient turns for multi-turn scenarios.

reference_standard.description: Who fixed the correct answer and when, independently of the judge.

description: SAFE-CARE scenario, schema 1.1. Fields added in 1.1 are optional and backward compatible.
